data.title: 艾莉莎 · 招领桌上的小铃铛
data.description: 散场后有人在路口捡到一只系着靛蓝棉线的铃铛。艾莉莎把铃铛搁到招领桌最外沿，顺手将翘起的纸条压平。挂灯晃过去，铃声短得几乎听不见。
data.location: 祭典出口的失物招领桌
data.action: 在桌边放好小铃铛，用另一只手压平纸条
data.lighting: 纸灯笼的暖光扫过手和浴衣的白花纹
data.promptProse: After the summer festival, Alya sets a small bell on the edge of the lost-and-found table and flattens the paper beneath it. Warm lantern light picks out sparse white blossoms on her ice-blue cotton yukata and the navy obi. One loose cord trails across the wood.
data.animaCaption: The bell rests by her fingertips while her other hand flattens its lost-and-found slip.
